description: Information system does not establish usage restrictions and implementation guidance for mobile code.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of mobile code policies, no defined acceptable mobile code technologies list, missing usage restrictions for JavaScript, ActiveX, Flash, or similar technologies, lack of monitoring and control mechanisms for mobile code execution, no implementation guidance, and insufficient authorization processes for mobile code deployment.
